config.name: Lagouvardos
config.notes: Exposed beach break, works occasionally. Best on W/WSW swell with E wind.

config.name: Krokala
config.notes: Open to the W. Works on W/WSW swell with E wind, like Lagouvardos but a bit more sheltered.

config.name: Vouliagmeni
config.notes: Saronic Gulf: only works on S/SSW wind events (notos). Short period, wind dependent.

config.name: Messakti
config.notes: Works almost only on summer meltemi wind-sea. Wind and waves arrive together.
